frontend_cases.name: dx7_alg5
frontend_cases.note: 292.800 units vs 204.166 before (x1.43), CI run 2026-08-07 (grame-cncm/faust-rs actions/runs/31206160924/job/92958106657). Cause undetermined: no commit in this session touches crates/eval, and no suspicious change found in eval/parser history since the last baseline update. --compilation-time shows this file's front end is evaluation-dominated (~85% of total, not lexer/parser), and evaluation time is highly variable even on a quiet local machine (739-1565ms across 3 back-to-back runs, >2x spread) -- consistent with this case having inherently noisy evaluation cost against a 25% tolerance rather than a targeted regression. Updated from the CI-observed measurement directly rather than a fresh `--update` run: this machine's karplus.dsp calibration compiles in <5ms, below the tool's own floor, on every machine tried so far.
